name: simorgh-grid
description: Simorgh Grid — National Electrical Project & Protection Operations Center

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/edge-gateway/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p db/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=@simorgh/edge-gateway && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:guardrails && npm run test:protocol
